content: The sun rises red in the morning and sets red in the evening; so too the truly noble remain unchanged in prosperity and in adversity.
author: Sanskrit Subhashitas
sourceWork: Udaye savita rakto rakto cha-astamaye tatha (उदये सविता रक्तो रक्तश्चास्तमये तथा) — Subhashita Ratna Bhandagara
explanation: The shallow mind becomes arrogant and hysterical with joy when fortune smiles, and falls into suicidal despair when hardship strikes. The solar soul, however, maintains the exact same dignified crimson glow whether climbing into dawn or sinking into the dusk of night.
practicalInsight: Whether you receive praise or criticism today, accept both with the exact same calm, serene smile.
reflectionPrompt: Are your moods violently tossed about by external circumstances, or have you discovered the steady center of your own soul?
